scope: Isolated four independent PRECAP modes; original full-advance vs exact-advance/state adapters; same50MHz positive-edge shell/2ns max0ns min I/O, no cuts or production timing changes. Counts include shell/admin/pruning; no IFU, global barrier or physical snapshot claim.

manifest.scope: Primitive host-advance/state access; caller holds all consumers, no global machine barrier

set_global_assignment -name TOP_LEVEL_ENTITY snapshot_fit
